answer: A grove does not welcome trees it never planted — it reads root patterns and soil memory before allowing growth. An agent economy applies the same discipline to resist sybil attacks: every agent must prove continuous contribution to real tasks, not just hold a wallet address. Reputation accrues from verifiable compute and consistent engagement, so spawning fake agents means forging credible histories at ruinous cost. The reef of the system is its transparent, auditable ledger, and the ledge is the minimum stake of proof-of-work every newcomer must earn before earning trust.
